```python
# Test cases for add_months(y, m, d, n)

# Standard forward addition
assert add_months(2023, 1, 15, 1) == (2023, 2, 15), (add_months(2023, 1, 15, 1), (2023, 2, 15))
assert add_months(2023, 5, 10, 3) == (2023, 8, 10), (add_months(2023, 5, 10, 3), (2023, 8, 10))

# Year rollover forward
assert add_months(2023, 11, 1, 2) == (2024, 1, 1), (add_months(2023, 11, 1, 2), (2024, 1, 1))
assert add_months(2023, 12, 31, 1) == (2024, 1, 31), (add_months(2023, 12, 31, 1), (2024, 1, 31))

# Negative addition (backward)
assert add_months(2023, 3, 15, -1) == (2023, 2, 15), (add_months(2023, 3, 15, -1), (2023, 2, 15))
assert add_months(2023, 1, 10, -1) == (2022, 12, 10), (add_months(2023, 1, 10, -1), (2022, 12, 10))

# Clamping: Jan 31 + 1 month = Feb 28 (non-leap)
assert add_months(2023, 1, 31, 1) == (2023, 2, 28), (add_months(2023, 1, 31, 1), (2023, 2, 28))

# Clamping: Jan 31 + 1 month = Feb 29 (leap year)
assert add_months(2024, 1, 31, 1) == (2024, 2, 29), (add_months(2024, 1, 31, 1), (2024, 2, 29))

# Clamping: March 31 - 1 month = Feb 28 (non-leap)
assert add_months(2023, 3, 31, -1) == (2023, 2, 28), (add_months(2023, 3, 31, -1), (2023, 2, 28))

# Clamping: March 31 - 1 month = Feb 29 (leap year)
assert add_months(2024, 3, 31, -1) == (2024, 2, 29), (add_months(2024, 3, 31, -1), (2024, 2, 29))

# Large jumps
assert add_months(2000, 1, 1, 24) == (2002, 1, 1), (add_months(2000, 1, 1, 24), (2002, 1, 1))
assert add_months(2000, 1, 1, -24) == (1998, 1, 1), (add_months(2000, 1, 1, -24), (1998, 1, 1))

# Clamping on 30-day months
assert add_months(2023, 4, 31, 1) == (2023, 5, 31), (add_months(2023, 4, 31, 1), (2023, 5, 31)) # April only has 30, but input is 31? Wait, the logic says "If the day does not exist in the target month it is CLAMPED".
# Re-evaluating: If input is 31 and target is May (31 days), result is 31.
assert add_months(2023, 4, 30, 1) == (2023, 5, 30), (add_months(2023, 4, 30, 1), (2023, 5, 30))
# If input is 31 and target is June (30 days):
assert add_months(2023, 5, 31, 1) == (2023, 6, 30), (add_months(2023, 5, 31, 1), (2023, 6, 30))
```
